notes: Surface: the form_submission member of a prerender speculation rule, its activation matching, and the eligibility check it enables - three rows, because a fourth row for the prefetch-discard scope would have needed a 'documented' examples cell and the page has no prefetch-discard example; inventing one to satisfy a mechanical requirement is the failure this contract exists to avoid, so the prefetch rule is documented where it belongs, in the field's context cell. Every dimension is marked documented rather than not-applicable: this is a small self-contained feature, and each of the nine questions has a real answer in the sources (the parse contract, the boolean input, the prepared-and-retained lifecycle, the console-warning failure mode, the rule-kind scope, the compatibility table, and the explainer's explicit security/privacy section with its TAG questionnaire). NOT settled in the sources and recorded as such on the page: whether list-only enforcement reaches the parser. The explainer intends list rules because document rules match links rather than buttons, but the PR diff propagates the member through the per-link document-rule path as well, so the page's hedge is the accurate form and this contract does not upgrade it to a guarantee. The declared-surface rule (gendn-4kq) has nothing to check here: this page declares no WebIDL, its surface is JSON, and the syntax block is a JSON example rather than an interface.
